tools.name: search_cards
tools.description: Use this when the user names a card, set, or collector number and wants to find matching printings or get card IDs for further lookup. Searches CARDZ public graded Pokémon or One Piece cards. Returns candidate printings with names, sets, languages, market ranks, PSA 10 prices, populations, market ca

tools.name: get_card
tools.description: Use this when the user wants detailed metrics for a specific card: PSA 10 reference price, population, market cap, price changes, daily history, and canonical URL. Requires an exact card ID from search_cards. Prices are daily published observations in USD, not live or executable quotes. Null values

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
